name: Interactive Volume Rendering with Multi-Dimensional TFs
definition: An interactive method using 3D transfer functions (value, 1st, 2nd derivative) where users can make regions opaque by pointing at them and 'paint' into the transfer function domain.
summary: This method lets users define multi-dimensional transfer functions by manipulating geometric widgets on a 2D histogram, solving the limitation of 1D TFs in distinguishing materials with similar scalar values but different gradients.
